caption: The drawing depicts a single teacup, positioned centrally within a square border. The teacup is primarily white with a faint yellow rim and is adorned with a detailed blue decorative pattern featuring what appears to be landscape or architectural elements on its exterior. The handle is visible on the right side of the cup. Below the cup, the words "Full Size" are written in blue. Beneath the main image, there is a smaller rendering of the same teacup, also outlined within a square, showing similar blue decorative patterns and yellow rim details. The background of the image is a plain off-white or beige color, and the drawing is executed primarily using light and pastel tones. The artist’s name, "Jas. Sayers," appears near the bottom right of the main square around the teacup drawing.
title: Cup
